hypothesis: Input high branch changes the learned-frequency sinc envelope, causing excessive or misallocated attenuation of useful features in the recipient eta1 context. The changed envelope is a major intervenable contributor to the old SC middle-band direction-flip class. May be rejected. No generic frequency correctness claim.
cohort_scope: Retrospective existing fixed grid. All32 middle families and16 unchanged-input low shams. Old16 flip families fixed in cohort; not a newtest or independent draws. No parameter/data search.

interventions.factorial: recipient U_i includes coefficient and unweighted Fourier sin/cos using recipient frequency+phase, own skip, point_i. W_j from donor eta_j at same coordinates/branch. Reconstruct (U0,W0),(U0,W1),(U1,W0),(U1,W1) with unchanged double MLP. omega in recipient carrier is not patched. Patch breaks natural carrier/envelope coupling, explicit artificial intervention.
interventions.uniform1: Uniform W=1-t, t=RMS(U1*(W0-1))/RMS(U1); matches total feature correction norm of donor envelope on same U1, no truth.
interventions.permuted1: Fixed permutation of128 frequency channels seed20261018, paired cos/sin. Wperm=1-gamma*(1-permute(W0)), gamma chosen to match RMS(U1*(W0-1)). No truth. Save gamma and all out-of-[0,1] weights; no clipping or replacement.
interventions.norm: Unweighted full4branch x4096query x256feature Euclidean RMS, same denominator; no decoder or truth weighting.
interventions.demand_control: Score <e0,d0>,<e0,d1>,<e1,d0>,<e1,d1> and output point1+d0 on same target. Does not require inference. Cross-alignment is descriptive decomposition, not standalone causal explanation.

scoring.primary: center16:48 middle Chebyshev Fourier band [.125,.25), nonDC; old identical transform
scoring.secondary: center and full64 RGB plus all3 prior bands, raw unclipped, all families retained
scoring.definition: e_i=truth-point_i; a=mean(e_i*d), g=2*a-mean(d*d); all envelope variants use recipient own point. g gain positive means MSE improved. Also report actual MSE/native difference.
scoring.focal_decision: No tuning. Major-envelope explanation supported only if >8/16 focal eta1 negative gains rescued to >=-tol, median targeted MSE improvement vs native >tol, median targeted improvement over both norm-matched controls >tol, reverse W1-on-U0 median gain decrease >tol and >8/16 decrease, and median fullRGB MSE no worse than native beyond tol. If any gate fails, do not call major explanation established. Report all32, old16, nonflip16 and sham16 separately. Stronger-attenuation premise separately requires median carrier1-energy-weighted (1-W1)-(1-W0)>1e-10; absent => reject overattenuation specifically even if pattern effect exists.
scoring.uncertainty: Dependent finite grid, no population CI. Full32 class is complete and old16 subgroup explicitly retrospective.

numeric.sham: W0=W1; swapped predictions exactly equal own original-rebuilt outputs within1e-10. Uniform/permuted are not identity shams and need not equal.

freeze: Archive code/protocol/cohort, verify original manifests and selected observation/truth/prediction hashes + inherited source/checkpoint. Generate all predictions/probes without scoring truth, freeze SHA then score. Prior truth is already known; freeze prevents outcome-dependent implementation, not prospective blindness.

budget.resume: none; launch absolute deadline fixed before child process, cumulative phase and parent timeout guards. Failure preserved. New root/version for code correction.

limitations: Single inherited SC checkpoint from LTE family; not allASISR
Known paired eta0 donor is unavailable in deployment
eta changes LR energy/gradient as well as high branch; not pure alias
Patch selectively changes envelope but hybrid internal state can be unnatural
Reference residual changes with eta; no stage causal fractions
No hypothesis expansion after seeing results
